Core Loop & Mechanics

Players connect and match adjacent dominoes on a board to clear level objectives. Each cleared cluster feeds a combo meter; sustained combos drive the light-RPG layer, where collected characters level up and unlock stronger board-clearing abilities. A single run alternates between board-clearing turns and character-ability triggers, keeping session length short but replayable across the ~4,800-level ladder.

Core mechanic

The matcher is a Match-3D collector benchmarked on Match Factory. Objects sit in a physics pile; the player drags items into a 7-slot tray. Collect any 3 matching objects and they clear from the tray. If all 7 slots fill without a match it counts as a blunder: the tray clears and surviving monsters enrage, but play continues. It is a tempo penalty, not a fail state - the loss screen only appears at zero health. Tray pressure is the primary difficulty

In January 2025 the studio picked its next prototype - a match-factory-style 3D matcher, which became Zombie Match 3D - but it did not move off Domino Delights. Core mechanic

The matcher is a Match-3D collector benchmarked on Match Factory. Objects sit in a physics pile; the player drags items into a 7-slot tray. Collect any 3 matching objects and they clear from the tray. If all 7 slots fill without a match, it is a blunder: the tray clears and surviving monsters enrage, but play continues. The level is lost only if the resulting damage reduces health to zero. Tray pressure is the primary difficulty dial.
